flags: STATUS UNCERTAIN: the park page has shown no online reservations since at least 2025-12-10 and ReserveCalifornia has the facility out of season for every date checked (Dec 2026 - May 2027). No official page says camping is closed, and none says it is first-come; only Campflare (aggregator) says 'Open year-round on a first-come, first-served basis'. The City of Colusa's website has no campground page. Worth a call to City Hall (530) 329-9198 if the reviewer wants certainty; status left open.

HOOKUPS: stored water true (note prose) is wrong - RDR marks every unit 'Water Hookup No' and the park page says 'Potable water sites (no hook-ups)'. Electric only at C05-C10 (C05/C10 50 A). The note's 'each site has water & electric hookups' was also wrong and is replaced.
SITE LENGTH: RDR posts pad length 24 ft (site length 30) on every unit - tight but fits a 23-ft rig; the plain sites are typed 'Standard Tent' but share the 24-ft pads.

FEES: stored fees ($28, electric +$10, from RDR June 2027 unit rates) are the rates ReserveCalifornia still carries, but nothing is sold there; what the city charges walk-ups is unknown. Left as stored.

WATERFRONT riverview -> not waterfront (recommendation; stored value is not --AWH): the loop is under closed canopy; the nearest water is a ~15-20 m side channel (creek-sized, under 30 m) ~100 m NE behind trees and lawn; the Sacramento River main channel is ~250-300 m east beyond dense riparian forest. No site is within 50 m of open water, and no sightline to the river through the forest. Stored evidence ('lawn ~45-55 m to a narrow slough channel') measured from the lawn edge, not from sites.
PHONE: stored empty -> (530) 329-9198 (City of Colusa City Hall, on the park page).
WEBSITE: the bare https://www.reservecalifornia.com line no longer applies (nothing sold there); suggest dropping it.
Pin 39.2172,-122.0142 is ~145 m SE of the RDR campground point 39.21801,-122.01550 (the loop) - under 250 m, left.
